guide_text.en_us: Growth temperature: 18–42°C.$(br2)Check the sapling tooltip; an active month and suitable climate are also required. Fruit grows on mature branches connected up/down with no adjacent fruit-tree leaves.$(br2)Root climate and fruiting months gate two stages using the berry growth setting; fractional time is retained. Right-click ripe fruit; harvest restarts the timer. Breaking a ripe branch also drops one product.$(br2)Northern trunk flowering months: 3, 4, 10, 11; fruiting months: 5, 6, 7, 12. TFC shifts seasons in the south.$(br2)Harvest Firmalife cocoa beans; bonsai yields the same beans for existing drying, fermentation and roasting.
guide_text.zh_cn: 生长温度：18～42°C。$(br2)树苗等待以物品提示为准，转枝须在活动月份满足气候。果实只长在上下相连且六邻无果树叶的成熟枝干。$(br2)根部温湿度合适且在结果期时，按浆果生长配置推进两阶段；余量保留。成熟后右键采收，采后重新计时；破坏成熟枝也掉一份产物。$(br2)北半球枝干开花月：3、4、10、11；结果月：5、6、7、12。南半球由TFC换季。$(br2)产物为Firmalife可可豆；盆景同产物，接现有干燥、发酵和烘焙。

diagram_text.en_us: Fruit develops and ripens on the exposed lower trunk.
diagram_text.zh_cn: 果实在下方裸露的主干上生长、成熟。
